window_definition.sowing_date: 15 January each year, design assumption not farm record
window_definition.duration_rationale: Upper end of IAS DH-1 published 70-75 day duration, transfer not reviewed

quality: Complete window coverage; overall POWER audit WARN and crop validity not established
limits: Hypothetical sowing window, not observed cropping calendar
Historical grid exposure, not coming-season forecast
No ET/crop coefficient/soil storage/irrigation; cannot compute water deficit or water saving
Tmax >=35 C is a diagnostic count, not a crop damage threshold
Outside flagged event by predeclared season window, not outlier cleaning
decision_use: Makes water availability and sowing calendar explicit review questions; does not select a best crop or certify eligibility
